reason: I want to plant the early crop, and lettuce seeds belong in the prepared trough.
expectation: The lettuce will be planted in one trough, perhaps completing the early crop goal.

alternatives.reason: The potatoes also need planting, but the lettuce is the early crop.
The foil and fabric might make a light cover, but I want to plant first.

effect: The lettuce is sown and the early crop goal is complete; I can turn to potatoes.
reaction: That was straightforward and as expected.
reason: The potatoes need a trough before I can protect their developing tubers.
expectation: The seed potatoes will be planted in the other irrigated trough.

alternatives.reason: Foil and fabric could make the cover, but I want to plant the potatoes first.

effect: The potatoes are planted; they still need protection from light.
reaction: The planting was predictable, with little detail yet.
reason: Foil and fabric are the only offered combination and could form a light barrier.
expectation: They will make a cover for the potato trough, though I am unsure of its exact form.

effect: The materials made an opaque cover, ready to fit to the potatoes.
reaction: The purpose is clear, though the assembly itself is quick.
reason: Covering the planted potato bed should keep light off the tubers and is the only offered combination.
expectation: The cover will be fitted and the tuber protection goal completed.

effect: The fitted cover completed the remaining goal and the chapter.
reaction: It is satisfying to finish a practical setup, though I wanted to know why the tubers need darkness.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making and fitting the opaque cover gave the potato bed a clear practical purpose and reused available materials.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two planting actions produced terse results; they felt predictable and offered little to discover.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the cover did what I expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but the game did not explain why the tubers need protection from light.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested to see the field trip and how the crops develop, although this chapter's decisions were straightforward.
